title: The sad truth is, some audiences are only watching to see you fail. They want you to stay in the pit because your rise intimidates them.
paragraphs: The sad truth is, some audiences are only watching to see you fail. They want you to stay in the pit because your rise intimidates them.
Stop looking left and right at your critics, and start looking UP to your Creator. Let the hands try to pull you down; they can’t stop what God is pulling UP. It’s time to climb. 🔥⚔️
"You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; you anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows." - Psalm 23:5
